name: @nanobpm/workflow
description: Code-first durable orchestration for nanobpmn (ADR 0044). Author durable workflows as ordinary async code — either an imperative function driven by engine replay (`defineWorkflow(id, async ctx => { await ctx.run(...) })`, the Temporal-style surface) or a declarative flow with human-in-the-loop signals (`defineFlow`) — and the SDK derives the executable BPMN model, the job types, and the message/correlation wiring, then hosts a generic worker. No diagram, no task-type wiring, no correlation plumbing authored by hand. Talks to a running nanobpmn gateway over the REST v2 API.

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:ci
